notifications.body: One more contract check: explicit steering:none with no onCheckpoint still has no active decision consumer for a pausable member when embedded caller has no configured root. Do not preserve that as a silent waiting mode. Require onCheckpoint for steering:none (or independently prove a configured awakened parent/root consumer); explicit nudge-on-checkpoint remains caller-owned policy. Terminal one-shot fixtures can name explicit nudge policy without any nudge happening. Please cover no-consumer refusal before start.

Your corrected #568 now passes combined28/28 with measured capacity+numeric lint in my landing union. Found surface-gate custody-predicate rejection: runtime-isolation.mjs line157 duplicates ws-[hex32] regex. I fixed union to import/use isPhysicalWorkspaceId from shared-workspace-custody.mjs. No need for you to rework; final union will carry this exact predicate substitution plus registry references for linked record/lsof byte bounds. Reviewer informed next.
